_doc: Caribbean × Navier (generic Dutch-Caribbean / ABC network) economic-corridor SOURCE block for finance/model/corridors.json. Tasklet authors enumerated legs + cost inputs + demand basis + modeled fare records; GROK seals route_id / from_node_id / to_node_id / distance_nm_verified / geom_verdict against the Atlas graph FIRST, THEN the economics cascade runs on the sealed IDs. Until then every corridor carries route_id:null and _status:PENDING_SEAL. broad-footprint-first, exact-bind-second; null beats confidently-wrong.
_lane: Tasklet = corridors+demand+fares(modeled)+country-ref+BP+narrative. Grok = seal geometry, then cascade economics, then sidecar. Do NOT hand-type the growth ladder.
_rename_note: This is the GENERIC regional network proposal, renamed from 'Caribbean Mobility Partner × Navier' to 'Caribbean × Navier' (Jaideep 24-Jun). NOT aggregator-led. Mirrors the French Polynesia destination-region structure. The old lumped 'caribbean-mobility' market + its single 'aruba-curacao-bonaire' node should be RECONCILED into this (split into 3 island nodes; retire the stub) — shared network, scoped view, never a parallel copy.
_shared_network_note: Curaçao is a SHARED node (golden rule #4). The same sealed Curaçao geometry/BPs also feed the dedicated 'ocean-whisperer' (captive-luxury) proposal as a SCOPED VIEW. Seal Curaçao ONCE; both partner views scope to it. Caribbean × Navier is the BROAD network view (all 3 islands, $900K commercial tier); Ocean Whisperer is the narrow captive-luxury view ($1M hospitality tier). Keep tiers distinct.

market.region: Caribbean — Dutch Caribbean / ABC (Aruba · Curaçao · Bonaire)
market.label: Caribbean × Navier — the below-the-hurricane-belt island-hopping network
market._fleet_basis_note: Grounded spine = Curaçao↔Bonaire inter-island + intra-island cruise/airport/resort/dive transfers across all 3 islands (Pioneer II, ≤70nm, commercial now). Klein Curaçao = seasonal amber. Aruba↔Curaçao (~70nm edge) and Aruba↔Bonaire (~95-100nm) = Quanta-LR roadmap (amber-dashed), never grounded on a 70nm boat.
market._capture_note: Captive ~55% (FP-style, per Jaideep 24-Jun; ABC resort/dive/cruise/inter-island-air transfer is largely captive). NOT FP's flat ~90%-saturation treatment — ABC has genuine network WIDTH to expand (3 islands, multi-corridor), so the cascade ladder MUST rise (broad-footprint growth ladder; SOM below SAM/TAM). See ABC-BUILD-PLAN.md.
market._capex_note: GENERIC commercial network → $900K/vessel Caribbean commercial tier (per Jaideep 24-Jun, decision #4 in ABC-BUILD-PLAN.md: Caribbean treated as the $900K tier, NOT the $600K Dutch-Caribbean-OCT tier, NOT the $1M hospitality tier). Tier stays DISTINCT from ocean-whisperer ($1M hospitality).
market._greenfield: ABC has no own census → cascade uses the labelled global template band (3.44/4.9/6.36), never a peer census file. Sanity gate: journey-GMV TAM must not exceed ABC's whole tourism economy.

corridors_grounded_pioneer_ii_commercial.demand_basis: THE GROUNDED INTER-ISLAND SPINE. ~30-45nm (squarely Pioneer II). Substitutes the live Divi Divi + EZ Air 19-seat turboprop market (high-frequency core route) plus cruise/dive cross-flow. Curaçao 1.57M arrivals; Bonaire 182,181 stayover (43% dive) + 359,000 cruise.
